feedback.text: dev is protected: never push dev; branch and open a PR into dev (memory dev-branch-protected, 2026-10-23)
oh one other thing we need to take into consideration...we need a control panel for the processing engine.  a way to control the flow of the data through the engine (Kafka).

so in short, what we need are 1. control panel to monitor and manage the processor 2. the lab in 48 3. all settings other than database connection information stored in the database like we always do. 4. real-time reporting on progress and status 5. exportable html reports on progress to users
and 6.  and this is the main one, we need a chat process that can do all of the above through chat as well as have a conversation with the user about optimization of processing.
and 7.  We need to be able to connect to the fusion-sql-mcp server
that's where we will connect to fusion to search for receipts and invoices

I like the idea of the fusion traffic being direct but the mcp server also provides value because  there's no thinking about connectivity...it just works.  so we're going to go through the MCP server for fusion connectivity
sorry...I meant to say the mcp server will be used to read from fusion, write to fusion via REST however, the receipt SOAP call will be done from the API

assumptions: Merges to dev go through a PR from the sprint branch (gh pr create --base dev; gh pr merge --merge), because dev is protected in this repo.
Repo is not Vercel/Supabase; deploys are OCI and happen only at release.
'the lab in 48' = the matching test console from issue #49, folded into this run.
Item 7: fusion-sql-mcp (AIX Greenlight MCP) is consumed as an MCP client from the API; read-only tools for chat/lab; Fusion writes stay on FusionClient.

Item 7 clarified: fusion-sql-mcp is the Fusion READ path (receipts, invoices) behind FusionClient; apply/writes stay direct unless the server proves it supports them; planner verifies the server tool list.

Decision: all Fusion connectivity (reads and writes) goes through fusion-sql-mcp; CLAUDE.md non-negotiable 9 refined. Gap: no SOAP/apply tool found in the server; planner verifies; apply gated off until it exists.
Final item 7: MCP for Fusion reads + REST writes; SOAP createApplyReceipt direct from the API (Vault creds). Supersedes the all-via-MCP assumption.
